content:
Class 10 Automotive (404) is on 18 February 2027; Class 12 Automotive (804) is on 22 February 2027. The table below keeps each registered course and its exam slot separate, so you can select the entry that applies to you.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Automotive dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 10: Automotive40418 February 202710:30 am to 12:30 pm IST2 hours
Class 12: Automotive80422 February 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours

Find your Automotive entry in the PDF

Open PDF page 4, 8 and look for code 404, 804. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The entries above do not all fall on the same date. A subject name alone is therefore not enough to choose a day. Copy the code and course label from your school record and retain only the matching row in your personal timetable.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 10 Automotive (404) falls 8 calendar days before English Language and Literature (184), which is on 26 February 2027. Class 12 Automotive (804) falls 11 calendar days before English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Keep school assessments separate

This row gives the scheduled board paper. Do not use it to guess a practical, performance, project or internal-assessment appointment. Where your course has a separate assessed component, obtain that schedule and the instructions for materials from your school.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

For the wider schedule, use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview and the paper-duration guide.
